//: Development harness of template-dashboard, not part of the template. It installs the two template packages under src-app/mfe_packages as workspaces and runs their type check and tests in one place. The packages pin their dependencies to exact published versions, which is what a product's copy installs. The overrides keep the harness on the React version the packages pin, so the tests run what a product's copy installs.
name: frontx-template-dashboard-dev-harness
